title: Board Settings
description: Configure default settings for new boards and manage global board policies.
read_only_message: You have read-only access. Contact an administrator if you need to make changes.
board_types_no_permission: You need the board create permission to manage board types.
page_info: Manage default settings applied when creating new boards. Check the checkbox next to each item to bulk-apply it to existing boards.

unsaved_tab_modal.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved_tab_modal.message: You have unsaved changes on this tab. If you switch tabs, your changes will be discarded and the saved values will be restored.

sections.general_description: Settings applied immediately across all boards on the user-facing pages
sections.basic_description: Default settings applied when creating a new board. These can be changed individually per board, and the 'Bulk Apply' feature allows you to apply them to existing boards as well.
sections.permissions_description: Default permissions applied when creating a new board
sections.list_description: Settings related to the board list page
sections.report_description: Settings related to the report feature
sections.report_policy_description: Configure automatic report handling and restriction policies
sections.auto_hide_description: Automatically blind posts/comments when reports exceed a threshold.
sections.report_abuse_prevention_description: Limit daily reports per user and block reporting when rejections accumulate. Applied globally across all boards.
sections.spam_security_description: Configure cooldowns and view count security settings
sections.report_notification_description: Configure which administrators receive notifications and how notifications are sent when a report is submitted.
sections.report_permissions_description: Assign roles that can view the report list and process reports (approve, reject, or blind). Admin notifications for new reports are sent based on the 'Process Reports Permission' role.
sections.attachment_cleanup_description: Decide when the files of deleted attachments are destroyed. Temporary attachments uploaded while writing but never saved are cleaned up daily regardless of this setting.

fields.attachment_purge_enabled_hint: Off by default — the operator must turn it on for the daily automatic cleanup to run. When on, files and records of attachments deleted longer ago than the retention period are permanently removed. Cleanup commands run directly on the server are not affected by this setting.
fields.attachment_purge_retention_days_hint: Restoring a post from the trash also restores attachments within this period. Keep it aligned with your trash retention window. (1 ~ 3650 days)
fields.new_display_hours_hint: Duration to display [New] badge after posting (1-720)
fields.max_comment_depth_hint: Enter a value between 0 and 10. Setting to 0 disables the nested comment feature.
fields.allowed_extensions_placeholder: Type extension and press Enter (e.g., jpg, png, pdf)
fields.notify_admin_on_post_description: Send email to admin when a post is submitted
fields.notify_author_description: Send email to the original author when a comment or reply is posted
fields.auto_hide_threshold_hint: Automatically blind content when reports reach this count. (0=disabled, 1–100)
fields.auto_hide_target_hint: Select the target for auto blind processing.
fields.daily_report_limit_hint: Max reports per user per day across all boards. 0 = no limit. (0–100)
fields.rejection_limit_hint: Reporting is blocked once rejections within this period reach the limit. 0 count = no limit. (Count: 0–50, Period: 1–365 days)
fields.report_cooldown_seconds_hint: Minimum interval between consecutive reports. 0 = no limit. (0–3600 sec)
fields.notify_author_on_report_action_descripti: Send a notification to the author when their content is processed (blinded/deleted/restored) due to reports
fields.notify_admin_on_report_description: Sends a notification to administrators with the 'Process Reports Permission' when a report is submitted. The number of notifications sent depends on the scope setting below.
fields.notify_admin_on_report_scope_per_report: Every time a report is submitted
fields.notify_admin_on_report_channels_help: Admin notifications will be sent through the selected channels
fields.notify_author_on_report_action_channels_: Author notifications will be sent through the selected channels
fields.report_notification_template_status_hint: Per-channel delivery, templates and recipients are managed in the Notification Settings menu.
fields.report_view_roles_description: Permission to view the report list and report details.
fields.report_manage_roles_description: Permission to approve, reject, or blind reports. Admin notifications on report submission are also sent to roles with this permission.
fields.blocked_keywords_placeholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
fields.blocked_keywords_description: List of keywords to block in posts and comments
fields.blocked_keywords_hint: Posts or comments containing registered keywords will be blocked
fields.post_cooldown_seconds_hint: Wait time between consecutive posts by the same user (0–3600 sec, 0 = no limit)
fields.comment_cooldown_seconds_hint: Wait time between consecutive comments by the same user (0–3600 sec, 0 = no limit)
fields.spam_security_identifier_info: Cooldown and view count deduplication identify members by user_id and guests by IP address
fields.view_count_cache_ttl_hint: Cache duration for view count deduplication (60–604800 sec, max 7 days)
fields.date_display_format_hint: Choose how dates are displayed in post and comment lists. Applied immediately across all boards on the user-facing pages.

descriptions.type: Set the default display format for new boards
descriptions.secret_mode: Set the default behavior for the secret post feature
descriptions.show_view_count: Display view count on post list and detail pages
descriptions.use_report: Enable reporting of inappropriate posts and comments
descriptions.use_scrap: Enable the scrap feature that lets members save posts to their personal collection
descriptions.use_reaction: Enable reactions such as recommend/not recommend on posts
descriptions.new_display_hours: Duration to display [New] badge after posting (in hours)
descriptions.per_page: Number of posts to display per page on desktop ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.per_page_mobile: Number of posts to display per page on mobile ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.order_by: Set the default sort criteria for the post list
descriptions.order_direction: Set the default sort direction for the post list
descriptions.min_title_length: Set the minimum character count for post titles ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.max_title_length: Set the maximum character count for post titles ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.min_content_length: Set the minimum character count for post content ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.max_content_length: Set the maximum character count for post content ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.use_reply: Must be ON to apply reply post feature to new boards.
descriptions.max_reply_depth: Set the maximum nesting depth for replies ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.reply_delete_policy: Set what happens when deleting a post that has replies
descriptions.blocked_keywords: Posts or comments containing registered keywords will be blocked
descriptions.use_comment: Must be ON to apply comment feature to new boards. Comment detail settings below will also apply.
descriptions.comment_order: Set the default sort direction for comments
descriptions.min_comment_length: Set the minimum character count for comments ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.max_comment_length: Set the maximum character count for comments ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.max_comment_depth: Set the maximum nesting depth for nested comments. Setting to 0 disables the nested comment feature ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.use_file_upload: Must be ON to apply file attachment feature to new boards.
descriptions.max_file_size: Maximum file size for uploads (in MB, {{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.max_file_count: Maximum number of files per post ({{min}}–{{max}})
descriptions.allowed_extensions: Enter at least one allowed file extension
descriptions.use_comment_reaction: Show reaction buttons on comments too. Works only on boards where "Enable Reactions" is on.

date_display_format.standard_description: Recent posts show as 'N min ago / N hours ago', this year as 'MM-DD', older as 'YY-MM-DD'
date_display_format.relative_description: All dates shown as relative time (N min · N hours · N days · N months · N years ago)
date_display_format.relative_example: e.g. 3 min ago · 2 hours ago · 5 days ago · 3 months ago · 2 years ago

permissions_table.title: Default Permissions
permissions_table.description: Set which roles can access each permission.
permissions_table.bulk_apply_notice: When bulk applying, the selected permissions will replace the existing roles of each board with the current settings. However, the manager and step roles of each board are preserved as-is.

bulk_apply.title: Bulk Apply to Existing Boards
bulk_apply.description: Apply the above settings to existing boards. Select items and target boards to apply.
bulk_apply.select_boards_hint: Search and select the boards to apply this to below.
bulk_apply.no_permission: Bulk apply requires both the board settings update and board update permissions.
bulk_apply.checked_fields_notice: All settings will be saved, then only the checked items will be bulk applied.
bulk_apply.no_boards_notice: No boards available for bulk apply. Please create a board first.

bulk_apply_modal.title: Confirm Bulk Apply
bulk_apply_modal.message: All settings will be saved, then the checked items will be bulk applied. This action cannot be undone.
bulk_apply_modal.message_all: All settings will be saved, then the checked items will be bulk applied. This action cannot be undone.
bulk_apply_modal.warning: This action cannot be undone. Existing settings of the target boards will be overwritten.
bulk_apply_modal.select_boards_required: Please select at least one board.
bulk_apply_modal.save_and_apply_info: Upon confirmation, all settings in the current tab will be saved, and only the checked items will be bulk applied to the selected boards.
bulk_apply_modal.save_error: Failed to save settings. Bulk apply has been cancelled.
bulk_apply_modal.permission_notice: The selected permission items will replace the existing roles of each board with the current settings. However, the manager and step roles of each board are preserved as-is.
bulk_apply_modal.aborted_message: An error occurred while updating permissions for {{board}}, so all changes have been cancelled.
bulk_apply_modal.aborted_message_suffix: : an error occurred while updating its permissions, so all changes have been cancelled.
bulk_apply_modal.aborted_message_generic: An error occurred during bulk apply, so all changes have been cancelled.
bulk_apply_modal.aborted_toast: Bulk apply failed, so all changes have been cancelled.

meta_settings.title: Meta Settings
meta_settings.description: Set the title and description for each page type to be displayed in search engines.

seo_friendly.title: SEO Pages
seo_friendly.description: Select which pages to provide HTML to search bots.
seo_friendly.cache_description: Manually clear the SEO cache for board pages. The cache is automatically cleared when settings are saved.
seo_friendly.clear_cache_no_permission: You need the site settings update permission to clear the SEO cache.

notification_definitions.title: Notification Settings
notification_definitions.description: Manage notification templates by channel for the board module.
notification_definitions.toggle_success: Notification active status has been changed.
notification_definitions.reset_success: Notification settings have been reset to default.

reset_modal.title: Reset to Default
reset_modal.confirm_message: All channel templates of this notification will be restored to defaults.
reset_modal.warning_message: The saved subject, body, and recipient settings will be permanently lost.

identity.intro: Manage policies declared by the board module and policies added by operators. Module default policies allow only enabled/grace adjustments; operator-defined policies can be freely edited or removed in core settings.
identity.purposes_section_title: Identity Purposes Registered by This Module
identity.purposes_section_description: Purposes declared by the board module. Selectable in the policy "Purpose" column.
identity.purposes_empty: No identity purposes registered by this module.
identity.no_read_permission: You do not have permission to view identity verification policies. The "View board identity policies" permission is required.
identity.read_only_notice: You do not have permission to change identity verification policies, so they are shown read-only. Adding, editing, or deleting policies requires the "Update board identity policies" permission.

reaction_types.title: Reaction Types
reaction_types.empty: No reaction types yet. Add one with "Add Type", then save.
reaction_types.none_hint: Add a type in the editor below first.

validation.code_format: Use 2-50 characters: start with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or underscores (_)
validation.name_required: Enter the name in the default language

reaction_types.confirm_delete: Delete this reaction type? It applies once you save.
reaction_types.icon_remove_confirm_message: Delete this icon? The uploaded file is removed right away, even before you save, and this cannot be undone. The default icon will be used instead.

messages.icon_upload_failed: Couldn't upload the icon — use a PNG, JPG, GIF or WEBP image up to 1MB

reaction_types.delete_blocked_suffix_one: reaction uses this type, so it cannot be deleted — you can turn it off instead

privacy_retention.title: Privacy Retention
privacy_retention.description: Automatically erases the author IP of posts and comments and the author information of guest posts once their retention period has passed, every day. Announce the retention period and erasure method in your privacy policy before turning this on.
privacy_retention.enabled_hint: When on, the core privacy retention job (runs daily) processes board data by the two rules below. Processed data cannot be restored.
privacy_retention.ip_retention_days_hint: Erases the author IP of every post and comment, including members' posts, once this many days have passed since writing. Access records must be kept for at least 1 year (2 years for large operators), so do not set a shorter period.
privacy_retention.guest_retention_days_hint: Processes posts and comments written by guests with the method below once this many days have passed since writing. 0 means they are not processed.
privacy_retention.guest_mode_hint: Anonymize hides only the author name and keeps the post. Delete removes the post from lists and erases its title, content and attached files.
privacy_retention.delete_warning: Deletion cannot be undone. Replies and comments under a guest post (including members' ones) are deleted with it, and attached files are erased immediately.
privacy_retention.preview_hint: Target counts are based on the saved settings. If you changed a value, save first and check again.
privacy_retention.withdrawn_notice: Posts by withdrawn members are shown as “Withdrawn user”, so they are not processed here. Member information erasure is configured in the Privacy tab of the core settings.

targets.title_ip: Author IPs to be erased (posts and comments)
targets.title_guest: Guest author information to be processed (posts and comments)

manual_run.save_first_hint: You have unsaved changes. Manual runs use the saved settings, so save first.
manual_run.confirm_desc: Run once now without waiting for the scheduler. The job is queued and processed in order; the result appears on this screen when it finishes.
manual_run.disabled_notice: Automatic runs are off. A manual run ignores the toggle and processes once with the saved settings.
manual_run.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Check the count and the target list before running.
manual_run.queue_hint: A queue worker must be running. You cannot run the same target again until its queued job finishes.
manual_run.queued_toast: The run has been queued. The result will appear when it finishes.
manual_run.preview_failed: Could not load the target count.

bulk_members.hint: Boards that would be left with no manager are skipped when removing.
bulk_members.confirm_add_manager: Add the selected members as board managers.
bulk_members.confirm_add_step: Add the selected members as board staff.
bulk_members.confirm_remove_manager: Remove the selected members from board managers.
bulk_members.confirm_remove_step: Remove the selected members from board staff.
bulk_members.no_permission: You need permission to edit boards to assign managers or staff in bulk.
bulk_members.load_failed: Could not load the board list, so bulk assignment is unavailable. Please reopen this page shortly.
bulk_members.failed: Failed to assign board managers/staff in bulk.
